name: Arts-Rec (Barrio Logan)
tagline: Skate, sneakers and streetwear on Logan Ave
description: A skate shop and boutique opened in 2018 by longtime professional skateboarder Kellen James. The Logan Ave original stocks hardware from Independent, Spitfire, Baker and Santa Cruz alongside apparel and footwear from Stussy, Nike SB, Vans and Carhartt WIP, and the shop regularly puts on skate jams, art shows and youth fundraisers.

name: Arts-Rec (Chula Vista)
tagline: Third Avenue skate shop and streetwear boutique
description: The second Arts-Rec location, opened in 2021 on Third Avenue in downtown Chula Vista, extending Kellen James's skate shop into the South Bay. It carries the same mix of decks, trucks and wheels plus sneakers and streetwear, and takes part in the shop's skate jams, art shows and local collaborations.

name: Casa del Rey Moro African Museum
tagline: 6,000 years of African history in Old Town
hours: Daily 10:30am-7pm. Small volunteer run museum, call ahead.
description: Founded by Chuck Ambers, this Old Town museum traces roughly 6,000 years of African and diaspora history with an emphasis on African Spanish, African Mexican and African American heritage. Alongside artifacts from more than ten African nations it houses a research center of some 6,000 books in nine languages, a gift shop and a heritage tour program.

name: Chef Budda Blasian Soul Food
tagline: Soul food with Blasian flair in Oak Park
description: A counter service soul food restaurant that grew out of a popular San Diego food truck and opened as a brick and mortar in June 2025. Owners Michael Price and Lily Nachampasak serve fried wings, catfish, shrimp and baked mac alongside rice and gravy, candied yams and greens, plus Lao and Thai dishes reflecting the family's Black and Asian roots. Catering and the original truck still run alongside the storefront.

name: Chula Vista Brewery
tagline: South Bay craft beer, Black and veteran owned
description: Craft brewery and taproom opened in 2017 by Timothy and Dali Parker in downtown Chula Vista's Third Avenue Village. The kid and pet friendly taproom pours house IPAs, ambers and lagers, including the GABF bronze medal winning Browner Than Ivan brown ale, and runs weekly comedy and vinyl nights.

name: Common Ground Theatre
tagline: San Diego's longest running Black theatre company
address: 4343 Ocean View Blvd, San Diego, CA 92113
hours: Office Mon-Thu 9am-8pm, Fri 9am-3pm. Performance times vary by production.
description: Common Ground Theatre stages classic and new works by and about people of African descent at the Educational Cultural Complex Theatre in southeastern San Diego. Led by Executive Artistic Director Yolanda Marie Franklin, it completed its 62nd season in 2026 and puts particular weight on arts education for children and youth.

name: Coop's West Texas BBQ
tagline: West Texas brisket, served till it sells out
address: 2625 Lemon Grove Ave, Lemon Grove, CA 91945
description: Lemon Grove barbecue institution run by pitmaster Bradrick Cooper, smoking West Texas style brisket, ribs and links alongside cornbread, mac and cheese and other Southern sides. After closing the storefront in 2024 it came back on a weekend only schedule, serving Friday through Sunday until the meat runs out, with catering available midweek.

name: Dancing Around The Oak Tree Art Studio
tagline: Inclusive art classes for artists of all abilities
hours: Programs run at partner sites and online, by appointment
description: A San Diego nonprofit started by Vickie Lawrence in 2014 that gives people with intellectual and developmental disabilities a supportive place to learn painting, drawing, mixed media and crafts. Vickie is an artist with disabilities herself, and instruction emphasizes both art skills and coping skills, with participants' finished pieces offered for sale through the studio's online shop.

name: Dirt Don't Hurt
tagline: Charcoal powered clean beauty from three SD sisters
description: An online brand launched by San Diego sisters Kaya, Sativa and Maritza Murray after searching for nontoxic products for their own families. The vegan, cruelty free line runs on activated charcoal, earth clays, essential oils and herbs across oral care, skin care and body care, sold direct and wholesale.

name: EDEN San Diego
tagline: Boutique plant nursery and gift shop
description: A family run boutique nursery and gift shop on Park Blvd in University Heights, open since 2017 as a sister store to North Park Nursery. Inventory spans houseplants, succulents, cacti, air plants, pots and locally made gifts, and the team also takes on interior and exterior plant design, delivery, installation and garden maintenance.

name: Finesse Products
tagline: San Diego skate, art and lifestyle brand since 1997
description: A San Diego skateboard, art and lifestyle brand started in 1997 by brothers Steven and Rod James, with artwork and graphics drawn by Steven and inspired by anime, video games and comics. The line covers decks, apparel, accessories and art prints, including licensed collaborations, and is carried by national skate retailers.

name: Fivespace
tagline: Hip hop vinyl, tapes and vintage
address: 2305 University Ave, Unit 101, San Diego, CA 92104
hours: Online store open 24/7, walk in hours unconfirmed
description: A North Park record shop founded by producer Sir Froderick, stocking hip hop and rap vinyl, cassettes and CDs alongside vintage apparel, pins, patches and books. It is known for rare titles, lathe cut records made on site and personal shopping appointments, and also sells through its own web store.

name: Freshly Faded Barber + Shop
tagline: Get in, get fresh, get out
address: 2850 El Cajon Blvd, Suite 1, San Diego, CA 92104
description: A North Park barbershop founded by Derrick Banks, specializing in fades, tapers, beard work and hot towel straight razor shaves for adults and kids. The shop doubles as a community space stocked with local art, books, pins and vintage magazines, and hosts men's health talks, screenings and voter registration drives.

name: Furlicious Pet Services
tagline: Mobile dog walking, sitting and bond based training
description: A mobile San Diego County dog care company offering dog walking, pet sitting and bond based training for dogs of any age or breed using positive reinforcement. Staff are certified in K9 CPR and pet first aid, the business is licensed, bonded and insured, and it also runs group pack hikes and a training academy.

name: Kebab Craft Mediterranean Grill
tagline: Cali Mediterranean kebabs, bowls and pitas
address: 2820 Historic Decatur Rd, Booth 32, San Diego, CA 92106
description: A Mediterranean and Middle Eastern grill at Booth 32 inside Liberty Public Market, opened in 2022 and built on family recipes shaped by Parisian training. The menu centers on build your own plates, bowls and pitas alongside signatures like the Cali Kebab, loaded fries and baklava.

name: Lili Kouture
tagline: African fabric fashion, designed and sewn in City Heights
address: 4274 El Cajon Blvd, San Diego, CA 92105
description: A woman and Black owned City Heights boutique run by designer Lalitibe Klu, who sews modern, easy to wear garments from cotton sourced in Togo and elsewhere in West Africa. The shop, also known as LK Fashion, sells dresses, separates and custom pieces across a wide size range.

name: Manuelita Brown
tagline: Bronze sculptor of Black history and everyday dignity
description: An award winning San Diego County sculptor who left a career teaching mathematics in 2000 to work in bronze full time, making figurative and portrait pieces that reflect the strength of African survivors in the Americas. Her public works include the Sojourner Truth statue at UC San Diego, Stepping Beyond at the Southeast Live Well Center, and the dolphin fountain figures at UTC.

name: Martin Luther King Jr. Promenade
tagline: Downtown linear park honoring Dr. King
address: 326 W Harbor Dr, San Diego, CA 92101
description: A 12 acre linear park running about three quarters of a mile along Harbor Drive from the Gaslamp Quarter toward Seaport Village, dedicated in 1992. Its brick walkway is lined with palm allees, some thirty plaques inscribed with Dr. King's words, and public sculpture including Melvin Edwards' Breaking of the Chains. It hosts the annual Martin Luther King Day Celebration each January.

name: Maya's Cookies
tagline: America's top Black owned vegan cookie company
address: 4760 Mission Gorge Pl, Suite G, San Diego, CA 92120
description: Founded in 2015 by Maya Madsen, Maya's Cookies bakes soft gourmet vegan cookies in flavors like chocolate chip s'more and marble fudge, inspired by her travels and memories. The Grantville flagship anchors a business that also sells at San Diego County farmers markets and ships nationwide.

name: Muzita Abyssinian Bistro
tagline: Eritrean and Ethiopian family recipes on Park Blvd
description: A University Heights bistro serving Eritrean and Ethiopian dishes built on family recipes, from slow simmered stews to vegetarian platters, all eaten with injera. The kitchen runs split lunch and dinner service daily and also handles catering and private events.

name: Nomad Donuts
tagline: Globally inspired donuts and wood fired bagels
description: North Park donut shop run by Brad Keiller, making small batch artisanal donuts in rotating international flavors such as ube and Mexican chocolate, with a steady vegan selection. The shop also bakes wood fired bagels and serves breakfast sandwiches and coffee.

name: OneWorldBeat Cafe
tagline: Vegan Caribbean plates inside Balboa Park
description: A plant based cafe inside the WorldBeat Cultural Center in Balboa Park, serving vegan soul food and Caribbean inspired dishes made partly with produce from the center's garden. It offers pickup, outdoor seating and limited indoor dining on the center's weekend schedule.

name: Puzzle Pieces Marketing
tagline: Nonprofit branding, web design and social
description: A San Diego marketing agency founded in 2009 by Angel Mason Broadus and co-owned with Kristine Mason Broadus, working mainly with nonprofits and mission driven organizations on branding, website design and development, graphic design, copywriting and social media. The company describes itself as Black owned, women owned, LGBTQ owned and veteran owned.

name: Reggae World
tagline: North Park's longtime reggae shop and apothecary
description: Operating on University Ave since around 2000 under owner Zulu Miller, Reggae World sells reggae music, T shirts, bags, patches and jewelry. It is equally known for scented shea butters, body oils, incense and imported African goods, and keeps daily hours.

name: San Diego African American Museum of Fine Arts
tagline: A museum without walls for Black fine art
hours: No permanent gallery. Exhibitions hosted at partner venues.
description: SDAAMFA presents and preserves the fine art of African Americans and the wider diaspora, operating by design as a museum without walls rather than from a permanent gallery. Founded in 1992 and revived in 2014 under Executive Director Gaidi Finnie, it mounts exhibitions with partner venues and runs the annual Keepers of the Culture honors.

name: San Diego Black Film Festival
tagline: Annual showcase of Black and diaspora cinema
address: 3555 Rosecrans St, Suite 114-215, San Diego, CA 92110
hours: Festival runs annually in late January. Office by appointment.
description: Founded in 2002, SDBFF is one of the largest Black film festivals in the country, screening more than 100 features, documentaries and shorts each year across San Diego theaters. The five day event runs during the last week of January with panel discussions, filmmaker mixers and an awards gala.

name: Sandalwood Skin
tagline: Custom facials, lash lifts and brow lamination
description: An appointment only skincare studio in North Park run by Natasha, a licensed esthetician trained at the Christine Valmy International School of Esthetics in New York. Treatments are built around each client's concerns, from dehydration and congestion to sensitivity and aging, and include 60 minute custom facials, lash lifts with tint and brow lamination.

name: Surf & Soul Spot
tagline: Seafood and soul plates, two menus a week
address: 7229 El Cajon Blvd, San Diego, CA 92115
hours: Mon-Wed 11am-7pm Surf menu, Fri-Sat 12pm until sold out Soul menu, closed Thu and Sun
description: A takeout spot on El Cajon Blvd from Chef Sarajevo Amor Petty with co-owner Sergio Bailey II. It runs two rotating menus: a seafood leaning Surf lineup earlier in the week, then a Soul menu of fried catfish, wings, pork chops, collard greens, candied yams and banana pudding on Friday and Saturday until it sells out.

name: WorldBeat Cultural Center
tagline: African diaspora and Indigenous culture in Balboa Park
hours: Fri-Sun 11am-5pm, closed Mon-Thu. Event nights vary.
description: Housed in a repurposed Balboa Park water tower since 1996 and led by founder Makeda Dread Cheatom, this nonprofit celebrates African diaspora and Indigenous world cultures through concerts, drum and dance classes, exhibits and festivals. It also runs the George Washington Carver Ethnobotany Peace Garden, a vegan cafe, and annual Kwanzaa and Global Earth Day celebrations.

description: Robb Field (Ocean Beach Athletic Area) at 2525 Bacon St is a large City of San Diego recreation complex along the San Diego River. It includes softball and multipurpose fields, tennis, basketball and handball courts, a picnic area, the Robb Fitness Club, and the City's first skateboard park, which opened in 2000. It's a central hub for youth and adult sports in Ocean Beach.

name: Saratoga Park
tagline: Family-friendly grassy park beside Saratoga Avenue Beach in Ocean Beach.
description: Saratoga Park is a small public park with a large grassy area adjacent to Saratoga Avenue Beach in Ocean Beach. It sits on a family-friendly stretch of coast between the busier Newport Avenue and Voltaire Street beach areas, near parking, food, showers, and lifeguards. The green is a popular spot for hanging out close to the sand and surf.

name: Sine Wave Cafe
tagline: Neighborhood coffee & breakfast with a laid-back OB vibe
address: 4810 Santa Monica Ave, San Diego, CA 92107
description: Sine Wave Cafe is an Ocean Beach neighborhood coffee shop and breakfast cafe serving specialty coffee, matcha, handcrafted espresso drinks, and fresh brunch items made with quality ingredients. Founded in 2025, it functions as a relaxed community gathering space for locals, surfers, and visitors.

name: Sunset Cliffs Natural Park
tagline: Dramatic bluff-top ocean views, sea caves, and world-class sunsets in Point Loma.
address: Sunset Cliffs Blvd & Adair St, San Diego, CA 92107
description: Sunset Cliffs Natural Park is a 68-acre resource-based park established in 1983, stretching along the Pacific Ocean on the western edge of Point Loma. It features intricately carved coastal bluffs, arches, and sea caves with panoramic ocean views, and migrating California gray whales can be spotted seasonally. The park is free and open to the public, with street and small-lot parking; there are no on-site restrooms.

name: The Harp
tagline: A friendly Irish pub & grill in the heart of Ocean Beach
description: The Harp is a friendly Irish pub and grill in Ocean Beach offering award-winning food, a full bar, and a large craft beer selection. It's a go-to spot for sports fans, showing soccer, rugby, MLB, NCAA football, and NFL, and features live music and a dog-friendly patio. Purchased in March 2024 by local residents passionate about the community.

name: The Holding Company
tagline: Holding on to good times
description: The Holding Company is a three-story restaurant, bar, and live music venue in Ocean Beach with the best rooftop ocean views in the neighborhood. It serves Asian fusion cuisine and craft cocktails alongside live music seven nights a week, including Karaoke Mondays and Reggae Tuesdays. Open since 2017, it hosts national touring acts and local favorites.

name: The Inn at Sunset Cliffs
tagline: A tranquil oceanfront boutique inn steps from Ocean Beach
address: 1370 Sunset Cliffs Blvd, San Diego, CA 92107
description: The Inn at Sunset Cliffs is a boutique oceanfront hotel in the Point Loma/Ocean Beach area, one of the few San Diego hotels located directly on the Pacific Ocean. Originally built in the 1950s and updated in 2018, the 24-room inn is designed after Santorini, Greece, and features a heated pool, oceanview terraces, and event/wedding spaces.

name: The Template
tagline: An OB art collective, cafe, and community venue uniting the curious
description: The Template is an Ocean Beach cafe, community center, venue, and artist collective operating as a 501(c)(3) nonprofit dedicated to fostering creativity and supporting local art. The space hosts open mics, live music, workshops, markets, and art exhibitions, and offers a large event space with lighting, projectors, and green/white screens.

name: Tony's Martini Bar
tagline: A fine bar in Ocean Beach
description: Tony's Martini Bar is a longtime Ocean Beach staple serving specialty cocktails and martinis with an old-school vibe, complete with a juke box and pool tables. The bar hosts karaoke on Sunday and Thursday nights and live music on Wednesdays. It also features a small covered smoking patio.

name: Ultreya Coffee and Tea
tagline: Bold flavors, small-batch roasting, and your new favorite daily ritual
address: 1785 Sunset Cliffs Blvd, San Diego, CA 92107
description: Ultreya Coffee and Tea is an Ocean Beach coffee roaster and shop serving fresh, small-batch roasted coffee, specialty drinks, acai bowls, and creative breakfast options. The thoughtfully curated space also stocks gifts and goods, with owner Danielle Riggins serving coffee in OB since the early 2010s.

name: Valkyrie Yoga
tagline: Yoga + Breathwork + Sound Healing
address: 4876 Santa Monica Ave, San Diego, CA 92107
description: Valkyrie Yoga is a community-centered, employee-owned healing center on Santa Monica Ave in Ocean Beach offering daily yoga, breathwork, and sound healing classes ranging from restorative and yin to vinyasa and hatha. Founded by Agnete, the space features natural bamboo floors, plants, and an outdoor garden, and hosts monthly events like open mic nights, ecstatic dance, and cacao ceremonies.

name: Winstons Beach Club
tagline: Serving San Diego's finest live music since 1986
description: Winstons Beach Club is an iconic Ocean Beach live music venue that has hosted local and touring bands nightly since 1986. The venue features a full bar with craft beer, plus open mic nights, comedy shows, and trivia. It's known for the longest-running musical residency in San Diego and has hosted acts like Slightly Stoopid and Steel Pulse.

name: Wonderland Ocean Pub
tagline: Oceanfront bar and grill with drinks, eats and pier views.
address: 5083 Santa Monica Ave Suite 2B, San Diego, CA 92107
description: Wonderland Ocean Pub is a casual New American bar and grill on Santa Monica Avenue near the Ocean Beach Pier, serving food and drinks in a lively oceanfront setting. It takes online reservations for groups up to 12, with larger parties by email request.

name: Yoga In Beautiful Places
tagline: Scenic oceanfront yoga, sound baths & moon ceremonies on Sunset Cliffs
address: 1352 Sunset Cliffs Blvd, San Diego, CA 92107
hours: Sunset Cliffs Oceanfront Yoga Thursdays 6-7pm (donation-based); plus new-moon & full-moon bluff sessions; registration required
description: Yoga In Beautiful Places is an outdoor-yoga and wellness business offering donation-based sunset yoga, meditation, and sound-bath experiences at scenic San Diego locations. On the Sunset Cliffs bluff (1352 Sunset Cliffs Blvd) they run weekly Oceanfront Yoga plus new-moon and full-moon ceremonies. They also offer SUP yoga in Coronado, beach classes in Carlsbad, private/corporate sessions, and wellness retreats.

name: Yoga Jawn
tagline: Free, donation-based community yoga on the Sunset Cliffs bluff
address: 1253 Sunset Cliffs Blvd, San Diego, CA 92107
hours: Sunday Vinyasa Flow 9am & 11am (Osprey Point); weekday classes at Adair St & Osprey Point; donation-based, all levels
description: Yoga Jawn is a San Diego community outdoor-yoga operation (the Sunset Cliffs Yoga collective) offering donation-based, all-levels classes overlooking the ocean in Ocean Beach and Point Loma. Its signature Sunday sessions run at 9am and 11am on the bluff near Osprey Point, with additional weekday flow, hatha, and gentle vinyasa classes at Adair Street and Osprey Point. Founded and led by Jackie.

name: 710 Beach Club
tagline: Pacific Beach's longest-running live music venue
hours: Mon-Fri 11:30am-2am, Sat-Sun 10am-2am; late-night menu daily 8pm-11pm; brunch Sat-Sun 10am-2:30pm
description: 710 Beach Club is a breezy beachside bar, restaurant and concert stage at the foot of Garnet Ave, a fixture of PB nightlife since 1989. It books local bands on Saturdays, runs Wednesday open mic, Tuesday trivia and karaoke four nights a week, and serves a late-night menu daily from 8pm to 11pm. Daily deals include $10 lunches, Taco Tuesday and Friday happy hour, and weekend brunch brings $25 bottomless mimosas and frozen slushies. The dog-friendly patio overlooks the boardwalk; 21+ at night.

name: bar Ella Pacific Beach
tagline: Coastal fusion with contemporary cocktails
hours: Mon-Thu 4pm-12am, Fri 4pm-2am, Sat 11am-2am, Sun 11am-12am; Happy Hour Mon-Fri 4pm-7pm; Brunch Sat-Sun 11am-2pm
description: bar Ella is a cocktail bar and coastal fusion restaurant on Garnet Ave in Pacific Beach, pairing East Coast comfort with a West Coast beach vibe. It serves handcrafted cocktails and small plates at friendly prices, with happy hour Monday to Friday 4pm to 7pm and a nightly lineup: Monday oysters, Tuesday Aperol spritz and pasta, Wednesday Tinis & Weenies and Thursday sliders. Weekends bring bottomless mimosa brunch, and it regularly hosts board game nights, comedy shows and Girl Dinner tours. Dog friendly.

name: Bare Back Grill
tagline: New Zealand flavor meets Pacific Beach chill
hours: Mon-Thu 11am-9pm, Fri 11am-10pm, Sat 10am-10pm, Sun 10am-9pm; Happy Hour Mon-Fri 3pm-6pm, all day Tuesday
description: Bare Back Grill is a New Zealand-inspired burger bar on Mission Blvd, steps from the sand, serving organic grass-fed and NZ Wagyu burgers, Kiwi-style dishes, craft beer and cocktails. Brunch is served daily, the patio watches the surf crowd roll by, and happy hour runs weekdays 3pm to 6pm and all day Tuesday. Part of the NZ Eats group; members of its Burger of the Month Club get a new burger on the house each month. Flip-flops welcome.

name: Break Point PB
tagline: Dancing, full bar, food and bowling on Garnet
description: Break Point PB is a Pacific Beach nightclub, sports bar and bowling spot on Garnet Ave with a full bar and food. It is one of PB's main stages for underground bass and electronic music, hosting promoters like Overdrive, Psychosis Events and Galactic Giraffe Group, and it is the neighborhood's Ohio State bar on Buckeyes game days. 21+ for club nights.

name: Cafe of Life Chiropractic
tagline: For you and your family through every phase of life
hours: Mon 12pm-6pm, Tue 9am-6pm, Wed 1pm-6pm, Thu 9am-11am & 1pm-6pm, Fri 9am-2pm, Sat 10am-12pm, Sun Closed
description: Cafe of Life Chiropractic is a holistic family chiropractic practice in Pacific Beach at 4535 Fanuel St, founded by Dr. Stephanie Williams. The office specializes in pregnancy, pediatric, and family care, with all doctors Webster Certified. Techniques range from gentle, low-force adjustments to more traditional styles.

name: Crown Point Park
tagline: Bayside park and shores on the north side of Mission Bay
address: 3700 Crown Point Dr, San Diego, CA 92109
description: Crown Point Park (Crown Point Shores) sits on the north side of Mission Bay in Pacific Beach, with grassy lawns, picnic tables, and a sandy beach. Amenities include a playground, basketball courts, a boat launch, and multiple parking lots. It is a popular spot for kayaking, paddleboarding, swimming, and picnicking.

name: Crystal Pier
tagline: PB's historic pier and cottage hotel at the foot of Garnet
description: The 1927 wooden pier at the foot of Garnet Ave, lined with the Crystal Pier Hotel's beach cottages, and home of the annual Christmas on Crystal Pier tree lighting.

name: Duck Dive
tagline: Pacific Beach's OG neighborhood bar, 120 steps from the beach
hours: Mon-Thu 10am-11pm, Fri 10am-12am, Sat 9am-12am, Sun 9am-11pm; Happy Hour Mon-Fri 3pm-6pm
description: Duck Dive is a surf-inspired neighborhood bar and restaurant on Mission Blvd, open since 2012 and just 120 steps from the sand. It is known for award-winning battered fish tacos, a famous bottomless mimosa weekend brunch and Wednesday trivia with themed editions. Weekday happy hour runs 3pm to 6pm, with nightly specials from Burger & Beer Monday and Industry Night to Taco Tuesday and Old Fashioned Thursdays. It is also San Diego's Nebraska Huskers gameday home.

name: Fitness Quest 10 Pacific Beach
tagline: Transforming body, mind, and spirit through health and wellness
description: Fitness Quest 10 is a San Diego personal training and group fitness company, with its Pacific Beach location at 875 Garnet Ave. The studio offers personal training, small-group classes, and functional strength coaching for all fitness levels. It is part of the larger Fitness Quest 10 organization founded by Todd Durkin.

name: Flamingo Deck
tagline: Be a Flamingo in a Flock of Pigeons
description: Flamingo Deck is a New American restaurant and bar with an Italian twist, located in the PB Promenade on Mission Blvd in Pacific Beach. It offers a rooftop dining experience steps from the water with brunch, lunch and dinner menus featuring pizza, pasta, seafood and steak, plus vegan-friendly options. Happy hour runs Monday through Friday.

name: Hideaway Pacific Beach
tagline: Beach bungalow eats a block from Crystal Pier
description: Hideaway Pacific Beach is a beach bungalow restaurant and bar located a block from Crystal Pier in Pacific Beach. It features wood-fired pizza, cocktails and happy hour specials. The venue is open daily until 2am.

name: JRDN at Tower23 Hotel
tagline: Modern surf and turf at the edge of the Pacific
hours: Breakfast Mon-Fri 9am-11am, Brunch Sat-Sun 9am-3pm, Lunch Mon-Fri 11am-3pm, Dinner Sun-Thu 5pm-9pm & Fri-Sat 5pm-10pm
description: JRDN is an upscale oceanfront restaurant and bar inside the Tower23 Hotel, steps from the sand in Pacific Beach. It serves contemporary seafood, sushi, and steakhouse fare with panoramic ocean views. The restaurant is open daily for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and weekend brunch.

name: Kate Sessions Memorial Park
tagline: 79-acre hilltop park on Mount Soledad with sweeping Mission Bay views
description: Kate Sessions Memorial Park is a 79-acre City of San Diego park at the base of Mount Soledad in Pacific Beach, offering panoramic views of Mission Bay and the coastline. It features walking trails, picnic areas, barbecues, open lawns, a playground, and restrooms. The park was dedicated in 1957 in honor of horticulturist Kate Sessions.

name: Kendall-Frost Marsh Reserve
tagline: Mission Bay's last remaining salt marsh
address: 2055 Pacific Beach Dr, San Diego, CA 92109
hours: Open for guided Wander the Wetlands events
description: A UC Natural Reserve on the north shore of Mission Bay protecting the bay's last intact salt marsh, open to the public through free San Diego Bird Alliance birding and science walks.

name: Mavericks Beach Club
tagline: SD beachside playground: games, sports, drinks, food, live music and dancing
hours: Mon 4pm-close, Tue-Fri 12pm-close, Sat 10am-2am, Sun 10am-close (varies for holidays and sports); Happy Hour Mon-Fri 4pm-7pm
description: Mavericks Beach Club is a 15,000 sq ft, multi-level entertainment complex steps from the ocean on Garnet Ave, with five indoor and outdoor bars, a nightclub, backyard games and reservable pickleball, basketball and futsal courts. It runs half-off drink happy hour on weekdays, Burger Monday, Taco Tuesday, Wednesday trivia and Thursday Country Night, shows every NFL game with football drink specials, and is home of the San Diego Cheeseheads Packers fan club. Dog-friendly patio; VIP bottle service and private events available.

name: Mindful Matters Counseling
tagline: Mindfulness-based therapy in Pacific Beach
description: Mindful Matters Counseling is the Pacific Beach practice of Marni Goldberg, LMFT, LPCC, offering individual, family, group, and teen therapy. The practice specializes in mindfulness-based approaches, cognitive-behavioral therapy, heart-centered hypnotherapy, and brainspotting. Sessions are available in person and online.

name: Mission Bay High School
tagline: Home of the Buccaneers in Pacific Beach, San Diego Unified
description: Mission Bay High School is a public secondary school in the San Diego Unified School District, located at 2475 Grand Ave in Pacific Beach. Its mascot is the Buccaneer (Bucs). The school serves students in grades 9-12.

name: Moonshine Beach
tagline: PB's honky-tonk for country shows and line dancing
hours: Tue 5pm-1am, Fri-Sat 5pm-2am; extra hours for 49ers games
description: A 21+ country bar and live music venue on Garnet Ave with touring country acts, Tuesday line dancing lessons and 49ers watch parties.

name: Open Bar
tagline: Classic dive bar a block from the Pacific
hours: Not published by the bar; a third-party listing shows Mon-Sat 7am-2am, Sun 7am-10pm (unverified)
description: Open Bar is a classic Pacific Beach dive bar on Mission Blvd at Thomas Ave, a block from the ocean, with a huge patio, friendly staff, cheap drinks, pool tables, a jukebox, free popcorn and DJs. Beach attire is welcome and locals call it home. The E.L.E. Burger smash burger pop-up cooks there Thursday, Saturday and Sunday afternoons, and resident DJs spin Sunday nights during football season.

name: Pacific Beach AleHouse
tagline: Craft beer and coastal vibes: PB's Broncos and Hawkeyes headquarters
hours: Mon-Thu 11am-11pm, Fri 11am-2am, Sat 10am-2am, Sun 10am-11pm (website; Instagram lists Mon-Fri 11am-2am); kitchen closes 10pm; Happy Hour Mon-Fri 2pm-5pm
description: Pacific Beach AleHouse is a craft beer brewpub and sports bar a block from the beach on Grand Ave, with a rooftop patio and beer garden. Weekday happy hour runs 2pm to 5pm, followed by a weekly lineup of Burger Mondays, Fiesta Tuesdays, Spin the Wheel trivia Wednesdays, Study Break Thursdays and Fri-Yay Fridays. It is the neighborhood's Denver Broncos and Iowa Hawkeyes headquarters, with every game on full sound, DJs, beer buckets and a football menu, and it shows all the other games too.

name: Pacific Beach Boardwalk
tagline: Beachfront path along Pacific Beach's Ocean Front Walk
address: Ocean Front Walk & Garnet Ave, San Diego, CA 92109
description: The Pacific Beach Boardwalk, officially the Ocean Front Walk, is a flat concrete pathway running along the coastline from North Pacific Beach toward Mission Beach. It is a popular route for walking, running, biking, skateboarding, and rollerblading, lined with bars, restaurants, and shops. The busiest stretch is near Garnet Avenue and Crystal Pier.

name: Pacific Beach Run Club
tagline: Free social group runs in Pacific Beach
hours: Wed 6pm social 5K; Sat 7am long run and 8:30am social 5K
description: A free community run club meeting at St. Paul's Lutheran on Felspar St for a Wednesday evening 5K and Saturday morning long runs with pace groups.

name: Pacific Beach Surf Club
tagline: PB's nonprofit surf club and contest organizer
hours: Club meetings 1st Thursday of the month, 7pm-8pm
description: A nonprofit surf club celebrating the Hawaiian sport of kings, running free monthly meetings and surf contests like the Tourmaline Club Challenge and Summer Longboard Classic.

name: Pacific Beach Tennis Club
tagline: Tennis and pickleball in the heart of Pacific Beach
description: Pacific Beach Tennis Club (PBTC) is a tennis and pickleball club in Pacific Beach, San Diego. It features 8 well-lit, well-maintained courts, a ball machine, competitive league play, and professional instructors. The club hosts a variety of events, clinics, and mixers.

name: Pacific Beach Town Council
tagline: Community advocacy and civic engagement for Pacific Beach
description: The Pacific Beach Town Council is a nonprofit community organization serving the Pacific Beach neighborhood of San Diego. It holds monthly general meetings, typically the third Wednesday of the month, and works on local civic issues and community events. Meetings are held at Crown Point Junior Music Academy (4033 Ingraham St).

name: Pacific Beach/Taylor Library
tagline: PB's nautilus-shell library with free weekly programs
description: The Earl and Birdie Taylor branch of the San Diego Public Library, opened in 1997, with an outdoor patio and weekly free programs like kids dance parties, ukulele, crafting and LEGO time.

name: PB Tuesday Farmers' Market
tagline: Fresh food, art, & air. See you on Tuesday!
description: The Pacific Beach Tuesday Farmers' Market is an outdoor certified farmers' market operating in Pacific Beach since 2011. It offers fresh produce, meats, cheeses, flowers, prepared foods, and handcrafted artisan works, and accepts EBT with Market Match benefits. The market runs weekly along Bayard Street between Garnet and Grand Avenues.

name: PorchLight Coffee
tagline: Your San Diego spot for coffee, bagels and baked goods
description: PorchLight Coffee is a Pacific Beach coffee shop serving locally roasted coffee, espresso drinks, and house-made cold brew. It partners with Desperado Bagels for artisan bagels alongside locally sourced pastries. The shop offers a relaxed, community-oriented atmosphere.

name: Pueblo
tagline: Modern Baja Coastal
description: Pueblo is a Pacific Beach restaurant serving modern Baja California coastal cuisine, located two blocks from the ocean. It opened in 2016 and emphasizes seafood, ceviches, street tacos and agave-based cocktails. Seating includes an open courtyard and a rooftop deck with two bars.

name: Revel Fit Club at MARA
tagline: A fully immersive boutique fitness experience
address: 4275 Mission Bay Dr, San Diego, CA 92109
description: Revel Fit Club is a boutique fitness studio delivering strength, cardio, and HIIT in 50-minute group classes. Workouts pair high-intensity interval training on TechnoGym treadmills with strength work using the FitBench. The Pacific Beach studio is at 4275 Mission Bay Dr, Suite 110, with underground parking available.

name: Riptides PB
tagline: PB's family-friendly surf-bungalow sports bar
description: Riptides PB is a family-friendly sports bar and restaurant with a Southern California surf-bungalow theme, serving casual American food with a Caribbean influence. It features around 20 TVs, pool tables, live music, and DJs, and is known for showing UFC events. Note: Riptides is at 1014 Grand Ave, San Diego, CA 92109, a distinct business from 710 Beach Club.

name: Ritual Wellness Collective
tagline: A space for your wellness journey
description: Ritual Wellness Collective is a breathwork, yoga, and meditation studio in Pacific Beach at 3510 Ingraham St, Suite 200. The women-owned and Latino-owned studio offers group classes, private sessions, and curated wellness events. Programming spans Kundalini and Vinyasa yoga, Yin, Reiki, sound baths, and structured breathwork.

name: Sandbox Pizza
tagline: San Diego's home for the Patriots
hours: Mon-Wed 11:30am-9pm, Thu-Sat 11:30am-10pm, Sun 9:30am-9pm (extended for Patriots games); Happy Hour Mon-Fri 12pm-5pm
description: Sandbox Pizza is a Pacific Beach sports bar on Garnet Ave that blends Boston culture with a SoCal beach vibe. It serves specialty and build-your-own pizzas, wings, fan-favorite Parm Pillows, craft cocktails and draft beer across 36 TVs. It is San Diego's go-to Patriots bar during football season, with weekday happy hour, Margarita Monday, Wednesday wings and wine, Thursday trivia, and fundraiser nights that give 35% of sales back to local groups.

name: SD Mission Bay Boat & Ski Club
tagline: One of the oldest boating clubs in the nation
address: 1215 El Carmel Pl, San Diego, CA 92109
description: The San Diego Mission Bay Boat & Ski Club is a nonprofit waterfront social and boating club on Mission Bay. Its clubhouse includes a full bar, galley, conference hall, and outdoor event space. Members take part in water activities, social events, and charitable initiatives. Note: the club lists its address as 2606 N Mission Bay Dr.

name: SD TapRoom
tagline: Serving local craft beer and gastro-fare since 2006
hours: Mon-Thu 10:30am-11pm, Fri-Sat 10am-12am, Sun 10am-9pm; Happy Hour Mon-Fri 3pm-6pm
description: SD TapRoom is a Pacific Beach craft beer bar and pizza restaurant opened in 2006, six blocks from the beach, with a sister brewery in North Park. It pours a deep San Diego craft tap list plus 75+ specialty bottles and serves pizza, burgers and tacos for dine-in or delivery across PB and Mission Beach. The large dog-friendly patio hosts weekend bottomless mimosa brunch, and it is the official home of the SD Detroit Lions Fan Club and the SD Seminole Club on game days.

name: Shore Club
tagline: Sunsets served daily where Grand meets the sand
hours: Mon-Thu 11am-2am, Fri 10am-2am, Sat 9am-2am, Sun 9am-12am; breakfast until 2pm
description: Shore Club is Pacific Beach's quintessential two-story beach bar at the foot of Grand Ave on the boardwalk, with panoramic ocean views, a beer garden and dozens of TVs. It serves Mexican-influenced seafood like fish tacos, breakfast until 2pm with the full menu all day, and is home of the RBV slushy. Known as San Diego's favorite Navy bar, it hosts Chargers game-day raffles, live DJ sessions, themed nights and its annual Oktoberfest.

name: Smiling Buddha Bodywork
tagline: Asian-infused massage, acupuncture, and herbal medicine
address: 4501 Mission Bay Dr, Suite 2D, San Diego, CA 92109
description: Smiling Buddha Bodywork is a San Diego wellness practice offering Asian-infused massage therapy alongside Traditional Chinese Medicine, including acupuncture and herbal medicine. Led by Licensed Acupuncturist Gary Williams, MSTOM, LAc, the studio operates by appointment only. It also hosts classes, workshops, and Reiki training events throughout the year.

name: Society PB
tagline: Pacific Beach's Eagles Landing on game day
hours: Mon-Fri 4pm-close, Sat-Sun 1pm-close; kitchen closes 10pm Sun-Thu, 11pm Fri-Sat (early opens for select games and holidays)
description: Society PB is a Pacific Beach sports bar, pool hall, restaurant and event center on Garnet Ave, open since 1989. It has 25 HD TVs and a projector, pool tables, and now serves Bubba's Smokehouse BBQ from its kitchen. It backs the Padres, Lakers and Philadelphia Eagles, and on every Eagles game day it becomes Eagles Landing, PB's home for Eagles fans. Society is also expanding with a second location announced for 2026.

name: Spice Lounge
tagline: Pacific Beach Indian restaurant with happy hour every day
description: Spice Lounge is an Indian restaurant and bar on Hornblend St in Pacific Beach, led by Chef Salwinder Singh Khinda, who cooked French and Italian cuisine in Europe for 30 years before opening in Southern California. The menu covers tandoori dishes, curries like saag paneer and malai kofta, veg thalis, samosas and house sauces like its fan-favorite Nirvana sauce, with cocktails and cold beer. Happy hour runs 4pm to 6pm every day, and it offers takeout, delivery and event catering.

name: Spitz PB
tagline: Mediterranean street food on Garnet Ave
hours: Daily 11am-10pm; Happy Hour Mon-Fri 3pm-6pm and all day Sunday
description: Spitz PB is the Pacific Beach location of the LA-born Mediterranean street food chain, open since fall 2025 in the former Crushed space on Garnet Ave. The menu centers on spit-roasted doner wraps, Döquitos, bowls and Berliner fries, with vegan and gluten-free options, plus San Diego craft beer, sangria and wine. It has a sunny patio, board games and a full menu all day, with happy hour Monday to Friday 3pm to 6pm and all day Sunday.

name: Studio Golf San Diego
tagline: Not your typical golf club
address: 4275 Mission Bay Dr, San Diego, CA 92109
description: Studio Golf San Diego is a membership-based indoor golf training facility at 4275 Mission Bay Dr. It is built around TrackMan simulators, PuttView putting technology, and Sportsbox AI 3D swing analysis, combining coaching, golf-specific fitness, custom club fitting, and members-only league nights. Complimentary day passes are available for prospective members.

name: Tavern at the Beach
tagline: Great Food. Stiff Drinks. Late Nights.
hours: Mon-Fri 2pm-2am, Sat 12pm-2am, Sun 11am-2am (opens 9:30am on NFL Sundays; hours shift for holidays and sports); Happy Hour Mon-Fri from 2pm
description: Tavern at the Beach has been a Pacific Beach bar and restaurant on Garnet Ave since 1997, known for one of the best happy hours in PB. It runs as a sports bar by day with 40+ TVs and game sound on, and a DJ-driven late-night spot after dark. The kitchen serves elevated comfort food, with weekly Wednesday trivia and fajitas, NFL Sunday, Monday and Thursday specials, UFC fight nights, Arizona Wildcats watch parties and private events with keg and bottle service.

name: The Collective
tagline: San Diego's premier private event space in the heart of Pacific Beach
hours: Open to the public Tue-Thu 6pm-10pm; Happy Hour Tue-Thu 6pm-8pm; private events other days
description: The Collective is a bar and private event space on Garnet Ave in Pacific Beach, next door to and partnered with SD TapRoom, which supplies its beer and food. Most of the week it hosts birthdays, weddings, corporate events and fundraisers with bar or full catering service. It opens to the public Tuesday through Thursday for happy hour, Tuesday trivia, free Wednesday comedy and Thursday live music. 21+ and dog friendly.

name: The Grass Skirt
tagline: Craft tiki cocktails, tropical bites and a lively speakeasy atmosphere
address: 910 Grand Ave Ste 101, San Diego, CA 92109
hours: Mon-Wed 5pm-11pm, Thu-Sat 5pm-2am, Sun 5pm-12am (OpenTable; the official site lists Monday closed, confirm)
description: The Grass Skirt is a tiki bar and speakeasy on Grand Ave in Pacific Beach, pairing craft tiki cocktails with Southeast Asian and Polynesian small plates from Executive Chef Brian Redzikowski. The room was designed by Davis Krumins with booth seating, fire features and theatrical effects. It hosts monthly Tiki Bingo with Sassy Stiletto and an annual Tiki Luau with a pig roast and rum tasting.

name: The Local Pacific Beach
tagline: PB's lively neighborhood bar steps from the sand, with a rooftop patio and nonstop events
hours: Mon closed, Tue-Wed 2pm-12am, Thu 2pm-2am, Fri 12pm-2am, Sat-Sun 10am-2am; kitchen last call 9:45pm; Happy Hour Wed-Fri 4pm-7pm
description: The Local Pacific Beach is a neighborhood bar and restaurant on Thomas Ave, a block from the beach, known for its fun-loving crowd, rooftop patio, new lighting and sound system and nonstop events. It serves pub fare and coastal-inspired food, runs Taco Tuesday, Thursday trivia into Thursday Club, Sunday Funday and weekend brunch, and books DJs. It is home of the SD Bills Backers and Pacific Beach's Michigan Wolverines bar, with game-day specials for both.

name: Thrusters Lounge
tagline: SD's OG home of the Seahawks since 1999
hours: Mon-Thu 5pm-2am, Fri-Sun 3pm-2am; opens 1 hour before every Seahawks kickoff
description: Thrusters Lounge is a Pacific Beach neighborhood dive on Mission Blvd, open since 1999 and named for the three-fin thruster surfboard. It pours 22 taps and cocktails, serves burgers, brings in DJs, and is San Diego's original Seattle Seahawks bar, showing every preseason and regular season game and opening an hour before kickoff, even for early games. 21+ only.

name: Tourmaline Surfing Park
tagline: North PB's classic longboard and surf contest break
description: A city surfing park at the foot of Tourmaline St in north Pacific Beach, reserved for surfing and a regular home to local club surf contests.

name: Waterbar
tagline: A social seafood experience with the best Pacific Beach sunset views
hours: Mon-Thu 11am-11pm, Fri 11am-2am, Sat 9am-2am, Sun 9am-11pm (Instagram; website lists earlier weeknight closes); Boardwalk Hour Mon-Fri 3pm-5pm; brunch Sat-Sun 10am-2pm
description: Waterbar is a boardwalk seafood restaurant and bar on Ocean Blvd at the foot of Grand Ave, next door to Shore Club, built around coastal classics redefined, shareable plates and signature cocktails like the passion fruit Aphrodite. Its ocean views make it one of PB's top sunset spots. It runs Boardwalk Hour on weekdays, weekend brunch with bottomless mimosas and Bloody Marys, NFL game days with a football menu, live music and late nights on Fridays and Saturdays.

description: World Famous is an oceanfront restaurant on the Pacific Beach boardwalk, serving Southern California coastal cuisine since 1970: market-fresh Pacific seafood, seasonal produce and hand-carved prime rib. It serves breakfast daily, weekend brunch, lunch and dinner, with a dog-friendly patio and one of the best ocean views in PB. Happy hour runs Monday to Thursday with rotating $3 taco specials, and parking is validated at the Promenade garage for up to 3 hours.
